name: Banh no
summary: Bánh nổ, as Vietnam Airlines describes it, is popped roasted glutinous rice pressed with cane sugar and ginger. It calls the cake a spring snack. The same article also lists bánh nổ again among gifts, with bánh thuẫn and bánh in, and does not describe those two.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls it pale yellow, lightly sweet, crisp, and smelling of new glutinous rice.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: popped roasted glutinous rice mixed with cane sugar, pounded ginger, and hot ginger water, then pressed into a block and sliced.
No street and no hour were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 30,000 VND for a 250 g bag.
seoDescription: Bánh nổ, popped glutinous rice with cane sugar and ginger. Vietnam Airlines prints 30,000 VND for 250 g. The hour is Check on arrival.
